benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.description: One free night award each cardmember year, redeemable at any Best Western hotel in the U.S., Canada, or the Caribbean.
benefits.terms: Awarded after the cardmember anniversary each year.

benefits.name: Additional Free Night Award for $10,000 Spend
benefits.description: A second free night award, earned by spending $10,000 on the card in a cardmember year, redeemable at any Best Western hotel in the U.S., Canada, or the Caribbean.
benefits.terms: Requires $10,000 in card spend within the cardmember year.

benefits.name: Best Western Rewards Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Platinum Elite status (normally requires 10 qualifying nights/year), including a 15% points bonus on eligible stays, no blackout dates on award redemptions, 500 bonus points per check-in, early check-in, and late checkout.
benefits.terms: Automatic for cardholders; no enrollment or minimum spend required.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Coverage for cell phone damage or theft when the monthly bill is paid with the card, up to $800 per incident and $1,600 per calendar year, subject to a $100 deductible.
benefits.terms: Requires paying the full monthly cell phone bill with the card. $100 deductible per claim.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $300 for reasonable expenses when a covered flight is delayed 12 or more hours.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $2,000 for nonrefundable, prepaid travel expenses if a covered trip is cancelled or interrupted.

earningRates.terms: 10 points per $1 from card spend, on top of the 10 points per $1 earned as a Best Western Rewards member, for 20 total points per $1 on Best Western stays.
